lead.claim: Variable dual-task training immediately improves lower-limb strength in older adults.
lead.context: Why this matters: This randomized waitlist-controlled trial investigated variable dual-task training for immediate and delayed benefits in older adults.

supporting.claim: Predict ankle reinjury in chronic instability considering sex-specific adjustments for fairness.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This 2-year prospective cohort study developed sex-equitable machine learning models to predict ankle reinjury risk.

supporting.claim: Many elite youth handball players report shoulder problems; WOSI can assess severity.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This prospective study examined the prevalence and symptom severity of thrower’s shoulder in elite youth handball players.

supporting.claim: Optimize peak torque normalization in adolescent athletes for accurate strength assessment.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study investigated how to best normalize peak torque in adolescent athletes to improve strength measurement accuracy.

supporting.claim: Smartphone in a pocket works for midlife mobility screening, simplifying remote monitoring.
supporting.context: Why this matters: This study compared front-pocket/thigh and lower-back smartphone placements for mobility assessments in adults.
